updates.note: Management reaffirmed the 27% EBITDA margin guidance for FY26.
updates.quote: Presently, we maintain the EBITDA margin of 27% for the current financial year.

updates.note: Management reaffirmed order inflow guidance of INR 27,000 crores plus.
Management reiterated revenue growth guidance of more than 15%.
QRSAM specific aggregate figure was not mentioned during the update on total order inflow.
Management reaffirmed R&D investments target of over INR 1,600 crores.
updates.quote: R&D investment although we told INR 1,600 crore, but I am confident we may cross INR 1,700

updates.note: Management reaffirmed capex target of INR 1,000 crores.
Reiterated export turnover focus of 3% to 4% to 5%.
updates.quote: increase our export turnover from presently 3% to 4% to 5% in near future

updates.note: Reiterated long-term export target of 5% in near future and 10% in long-term.

new_promises.statement: We target R&D investments of more than INR 2,000 crores next year.
new_promises.quote: next year, it will be more than INR 2,000 crores.
new_promises.speaker: Manoj Jain

new_promises.statement: We aim to cross 10% of our turnover through non-defense leads in the near future.
new_promises.quote: in near future we will try to cross 10% of our turnover through these non-defense leads.
new_promises.speaker: Manoj Jain

new_promises.statement: Our aim is minimum INR 1,000 crores next year onwards from data center business.
new_promises.quote: Our aim is minimum INR (+1,000) crore next year onwards from data center type of business.
new_promises.speaker: Manoj Jain

new_promises.statement: We target minimum 20% year-on-year growth in R&D investments.
new_promises.quote: minimum 20% year-on-year growth investment we have committed now.
new_promises.speaker: Manoj Jain
